products-pagination-500.description: GET /products with page=0, page=-1 or limit=-1 returns 500 instead of a 400 validation error

products-invalid-id-500.description: GET /products/{id} with a non-UUID id returns 500 instead of 400/404

search-country-relevance.description: Searching for a country name ranks loose text matches first: "Syria" returns 8 syrup products from the UAE and Lebanon before any of the 187 Syrian products

threshold-empty-cart-message.description: NEEDS PRODUCT CONFIRMATION. With an empty cart the threshold bar shows "Spend AED 200, delivery's on us" (no amount to the minimum, no progress line); the brief expects "50 more and you're good to go"

cart-no-quantity-limit.description: PATCH /cart/update accepts quantity 9999 for one product (200): no stock or sanity limit

home-test-content-visible.description: Test data is visible to shoppers on the home page: deal cards and footer show "TEST ..." deals and a "foobar" basket

footer-shop-missing-bakery.description: Footer "Shop" column lists 5 categories; Shop by category shows 6 (Bakery is missing from the footer)

inconsistent-label-casing.description: Inconsistent label casing: deal "BUY 1 GET 1 FREE" is all capitals; footer mixes "About Us"/"Return Policy" with "Contact us"/"Track order"

notice-conflicts-with-same-day-badge.description: While the store banner says deliveries are paused, the hero still promises "Same-day delivery across Dubai, Sharjah and Ajman"

ar-page-title-not-translated.description: The Arabic home page (/ar/) keeps the English <title> "Dukkanti | Your favorite products, delivered"

language-reset-by-home-url.description: After browsing in Arabic, opening the home address "/" shows English and overwrites the saved PARAGLIDE_LOCALE cookie with "en", so later pages are English too

mobile-logo-link-unnamed.description: Below 380px wide the header logo link has no accessible name: its only text ("Dukkanti") is hidden and the logo image has alt=""

seo-missing-hreflang.description: The home page has no <link rel="alternate" hreflang="en|ar"> tags for its English and Arabic versions

home-axe-serious.description: axe (WCAG 2.1 AA) serious issues: colour contrast on the inactive "Best prices" tab (1.57:1), grey "Brand · Country" lines and struck-through prices (3.29:1), deal "Ends <date>" (3.07:1); header cart button is named "Cart" but shows "0 items 0.00" (label-content-name-mismatch)

threshold-amount-not-announced.description: The threshold bar's amount is invisible to screen readers: the button and progressbar are named "more and you're good to go" (the animated number is aria-hidden)

cart-fractional-quantity-500.description: POST /cart/add and PATCH /cart/update with a fractional quantity (1.5) answer 500 instead of a 400 validation error

cart-malformed-product-id-500.description: POST /cart/add with a productId that is not a UUID answers 500 instead of 400

cart-delete-missing-line-200.description: DELETE /cart/{itemId} with an id that is not in the cart (or not a UUID) answers 200 and silently does nothing, instead of 404

special-item-price-range-not-validated.description: A "Request an item" cart line is accepted with minPrice above maxPrice, or with a negative price, and the negative amount is subtracted from the subtotal

coupon-error-shape.description: Coupon errors use { message, messageAr, status, error } instead of the API-wide { message, error, statusCode } shape

cart-zero-quantity-line.description: POST /cart/add with quantity 0 for a product not in the cart creates a cart line with quantity 0 (201) instead of refusing it or doing nothing

delivery-badge-wrong-count.description: The badge on "See the items in this delivery" (cart, drawer, checkout) shows the quantity of the first line, not the number of items: lines of 30 + 1 + 1 show 30

business-form-field-mismatch.description: The Business inquiry form sends companyName/contactName/phone, but POST /forms/business expects fullName/businessName/phoneNumber: every inquiry from the website fails with 400 ("fullName should not be empty", "businessName should not be empty", "Enter a valid phone number")

contact-phone-not-validated.description: The Contact form accepts a phone number made of letters ("call me maybe") and sends it; no client-side check

soft-404-unknown-category.description: /products/categories/<unknown> answers 200 and shows the full product list instead of a 404 (soft 404: bad for SEO and confusing for shoppers)

sitemap-500.description: The sitemap named in robots.txt answers 500

checkout-double-submit-two-orders.description: SERIOUS. Two POST /cart/checkout calls sent at the same moment (cash on delivery) both answer 201 and place two orders from one cart

address-city-outside-delivery-area.description: POST /users/address accepts city "Abu Dhabi" (201) although the store only delivers to Dubai, Sharjah and Ajman

address-geopoint-not-validated.description: POST /users/address accepts a geoPoint whose coordinates are text (["north","east"]) with 201 instead of 400

address-invalid-id-500.description: PATCH and DELETE /users/address/{id} with an id that is not a UUID answer 500 instead of 400/404

wishlist-invalid-id-500.description: POST /wishlist/add with a productId that is not a UUID answers 500 instead of 400

wishlist-remove-missing-200.description: DELETE /wishlist/{itemId} for an entry that does not exist answers 200; DELETE /users/address/{id} answers 404 for the same case

wishlist-flag-and-filter-ignored.description: For a signed-in customer with a saved product, GET /products/{id} and /products/slug/{slug} return isInWishlist: false, and GET /products?wishlist=true ignores the filter and returns every product

orders-pagination-500.description: GET /orders with page=0, page=-1 or limit=-5 answers 500 instead of a 400 validation error

order-item-price-string.description: GET /orders/{id} sends item prices as strings ("2.50") while GET /cart and the order totals send numbers

contact-email-optional-in-api.description: The contact page requires an email, but POST /forms/contact accepts a message without one (an empty body only names fullName and message)

contact-name-type-unchecked.description: POST /forms/contact accepts a fullName that is a number (12345) without a validation error

site-grey-text-contrast.description: Colour contrast on every page: the secondary grey #8a8f8a ("Brand · Country" on product cards, struck-through prices, deal "Ends …", account and policy side-menu titles, form placeholders) is 2.9-3.3:1 on white and light green, below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum

header-cart-label-mismatch.description: On every page the header cart button has aria-label "Cart" but shows "0 items 0.00", so voice-control users who say what they see cannot activate it (axe label-content-name-mismatch)

ar-static-pages-not-translated.description: The Arabic policy and About pages (/ar/delivery, /ar/about, ...) show English headings and text ("Delivery Policy", "About Us")

signin-dialog-focus-not-returned.description: Closing the sign-in dialog with Escape leaves the keyboard focus nowhere (on the page body) instead of returning it to the button that opened it (WCAG 2.4.3)

baskets-rows-not-keyboard-scrollable.description: /baskets: the product row in each basket card scrolls sideways but cannot be reached or scrolled with the keyboard (axe scrollable-region-focusable, 8 elements)

openapi-baskets-undocumented.description: The OpenAPI spec (GET /v1/api-json) does not list GET /v1/baskets, which the storefront calls on /baskets and the home page

openapi-response-schemas-wrong.description: The OpenAPI spec does not match real responses: nullable numbers/strings typed as "object" (promotion buyQuantity/getQuantity, info campaignOffer.minimumSubtotal, address googleMapsUrl, order previous*Amount, deliveryDate); cart appliedCoupons is an array but typed as one object; brand nameAr can be null; GET /orders data typed as string[]; GET /orders/{id} marks 8 fields required that are never sent (paymentIntentId, onMyWayAt, arrivedAt, isFirstOrder, specialItems, ...) and item prices come back as strings

openapi-error-responses-undocumented.description: The OpenAPI spec documents only 200 for GET /v1/products/{id}; an unknown id answers 404, which is not documented

aria-label-hides-visible-text.description: Signed-in pages: links and buttons whose aria-label replaces the visible text (axe label-content-name-mismatch, WCAG 2.5.3): header account button "Account" (shows "Hello, <name>"), sidebar card "Profile", count links "40 Orders" / "0 Wishlist" / "3 Addresses" (sidebar and account menu), order cards "View order #10442". Voice-control users cannot click them by what they see; cart drawer "See the items in this delivery"

blocked-badge-contrast.description: The red "Blocked" notifications badge (profile page and account menu) is #b94b4b on #fbefea, contrast 4.46:1, under the 4.5:1 minimum for small text (WCAG 1.4.3)

signed-in-header-starts-as-guest.description: For the first moment after a page loads (until GET /users/me answers, ~1-2 s, longer on slow connections) a signed-in customer sees the guest header ("Wishlist", "Cart", no account button). Tapping the cart in that moment opens "Sign in or create an account" instead of the cart

order-tracker-a11y.description: Order detail status tracker: the progress bar (role=progressbar, "Placed" 1 of 4) has no accessible name (axe aria-progressbar-name), and the upcoming steps "Packed", "On the way", "Delivered" are #8eaea2 on #1b4d3e, contrast 4:1, under 4.5:1
